title: SPE — How this video was made
_comment: Narration beats for cards/outro.html (~38 s spoken; keep each beat ≤ 18 words). Rebuild: RESYNTH=1 bash scripts/make-series.sh cards

scenes.narr: This video was generated, not edited: each scene is one line of JSON, a narration beat plus a visual.
The voice is Google Cloud Chirp 3 HD, and the clip lengths set all of the timing.
The screens are a kiosk Firefox driven by geckodriver, captured at native 4K with gpu screen recorder.
The intro, outro, and titles are HTML and CSS animations, rendered frame by frame in headless Chromium.
ffmpeg stitched it together, and the whole pipeline was written with Claude Code.
It's all in the repo. Thanks for watching.
